description.value:
You can harness your connection to Vaeraustraee to emulate her warrior aspect, entering the Cresent Dance. To do so, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor or using a shield. It graces you with supernatural speed, agility, and focus.

You can use a Bonus Action to start the Crescent Dance, which lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if you are Incapacitated, if you don medium or heavy armor or a shield. You can also dismiss the Crescent Dance at any time you choose (no action required).

While your Crescent Dance is active, you gain the following benefits:

  • You gain a bonus to your AC equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
  • Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
  • You have Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
  • You gain a bonus to any Constitution Saving Throws you make to maintain Concentration on a spell. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
  • If you currently have a Spiritual Weapon summoned via the spell of the same name and you move on your turn, you can move your Spiritual Weapon the same distance.

You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a Short or a Long Rest.
